scope: Every governed source investigation, model-tier evaluation, and A1-A10 analysis updates planning evidence without silently changing a frozen run.

update_cycle.rule: Record finding, provenance, negative evidence and uncertainty without restricted text.
Classify metadata clarification, gate change, design change, empirical-input change or incident.
Identify affected assignments, routes, renditions, model cells, estimands, claims, custody and handoffs.
Propose the smallest change with rationale, alternatives and rejected options.
Use isolated agent-panel assessment and deterministic validation; agents cannot close accountable gates.
Accountable source, community, ethics/privacy, incident and promotion authorities decide only their scopes.
Run schemas, mutations, drift, Conductor, typing, payload/secret scans and relevant QC.
Any empirical endpoint, model, prompt, evidence, sampling, outcome, margin or code change requires a new freeze.
Update payload-safe report, blockers, decisions and handoff; retain superseded versions and deviations.

change_classes.planning_patch: No empirical or gate effect; validate and version only.
change_classes.prospective_amendment: Future-study change before affected outcomes; amendment ID, rationale, hashes and new freeze.
change_classes.new_run: Affected data exist, unblinding occurred, or endpoint/evidence/code drifted; preserve prior run and start new freeze.
change_classes.stop_and_incident: Rights, privacy, community, safety, secret, payload or reproducibility breach; stop and issue payload-safe receipt.

anti_post_hoc_controls: never change progression thresholds from observed performance
never select model source language margin endpoint or exclusion after affected outcomes
never delete null failed blocked or non-estimable results
never repair frozen result with later release

cadence.per_batch: cross-catalogue and blocker review before PR
cadence.after_execution: locked analysis, deviation and learning record
